description: AGSC-07-25 as amended 2026-11-10: in `brief.mmd` a member's node is named `n_` and its slug with each `-` written `_`, so that a member named `end`, a word Mermaid reserves, or `system`, the name of the architecture in the C4 files of AGSC-07-29, is a node like any other. `end` requires `system`, and `flow-chart` uses `end`; the selection is `end` and `flow-chart`, and the closure adds `system`. The case states the flowchart lines, after the four comment lines that `diagram.mmd` opens with: the nodes in dependency order (`flow-chart` and `system` have no dependency and come by slug, `end` after `system`), then the authored edges inside the selection in the order of `relations`. Derived by hand from the rule.

cases.flowchart:
flowchart TD
  n_flow_chart["flow-chart"]
  n_system["system"]
  n_end["end"]
  n_end -->|requires| n_system
  n_flow_chart -->|uses| n_end
cases.name: reserved-words-as-slugs
